$comment: High or critical advisories that affect BUILD TOOLING ONLY (never code that ships in the app; scripts/audit-gate.mjs checks that by reading the real bundle). Each entry needs a reason and an expiry. Add or renew entries only on the founder's go-ahead.

allowed.reason: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized input. Used only by Expo's CLI and the ESLint react-hooks plugin on developer and CI machines, never in the app bundle. The fix exists only in zod 4.6.6+, while Expo's tooling uses zod 3.x, so it cannot be updated from here.
